summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of Stripe webhook implementation for RouteCast. Discovered and fixed 3 bugs in the webhook handler. All 14 tests now passing.

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Returned 'annual' instead of 'yearly' which didn't match SubscriptionPlan enum value
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed return value from 'annual' to 'yearly' to match SubscriptionPlan.YEARLY enum

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Set 'plan' field but not 'subscription_plan' field when revoking premium
Only considered 'active' and 'trialing' as premium statuses, ignoring 'canceling' and 'past_due' grace periods
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added 'canceling' and 'past_due' to premium status check

tests_executed: TestSubscriptionPlansEndpoint::test_get_subscription_plans - GET /api/subscription/plans returns monthly and yearly plans
TestAuthAndUserProfile::test_signup_new_user - POST /api/auth/signup creates user and returns tokens
TestAuthAndUserProfile::test_get_me_authenticated - GET /api/auth/me returns user profile with is_premium status
TestSubscriptionUpdatedWebhook::test_subscription_updated_to_canceled_status - User keeps premium during cancellation period
TestSubscriptionUpdatedWebhook::test_subscription_updated_past_due - User keeps premium during past_due grace period
critical_code_review_comments: The webhook handler correctly uses email-based user lookup for generic payment links (buy.stripe.com)
Background task processing requires adequate wait time (2 seconds) for database updates
All webhook events return 200 immediately to prevent Stripe retries
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own test user with unique email (prefixed with test type)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe webhook implementation is fully tested and working. All webhook events (checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted) correctly update user premium status. Email-based user lookup works for generic payment links. Tests use 2-second waits after webhook calls to allow background task completion.

details: Fixed 'annual' vs 'yearly' plan name mismatch in determine_plan()
Fixed missing subscription_plan field update in handle_subscription_deleted()
Fixed premium status check to include 'canceling' and 'past_due' grace periods
